faq.q: What specific material properties make Titanium Lithography Stage Flexure suitable for Monolithic flexure mount for lithography mirror stage?
faq.a: Titanium Lithography Stage Flexure uses Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V because its yield strength, fatigue endurance, and corrosion resistance directly address lithography operational demands. The alloy's specific strength enables mass reduction without section compromise, while the TiO2 passivation ensures long-term environmental resistance.

faq.q: What are the critical dimensional tolerances for Titanium Lithography Stage Flexure?
faq.a: Standard machining tolerance for Titanium Lithography Stage Flexure is +/-0.05mm (ISO 2768-m). Functional mating surfaces are held to +/-0.025mm with Ra 0.8um finish, verified specifically for monolithic flexure mount requirements. Threaded features conform to ISO 965-2 Class 6g, verified with calibrated Go/No-Go ring gauges on 100% of production.

faq.q: Does Titanium Lithography Stage Flexure require any post-machining surface treatment?
faq.a: Yes. monolithic flexure mount components require Electropolishing Ra <0.25um + UHP DI cascade rinse with particle count verification per MIL-STD-1246 Class 1 — tailored for monolithic flexure mount application. This restores the natural TiO2 passive layer removed during machining and provides the required surface properties for the specific service environment. Key parameters include surface finish Ra 0.8um and passive layer thickness verification per applicable standards.

faq.q: What quality documentation is included with Titanium Lithography Stage Flexure shipments?
faq.a: Each shipment of Titanium Lithography Stage Flexure includes: (1) EN 10204 Type 3.1 MTR with full chemical analysis and mechanical properties; (2) Certificate of Conformance confirming all processes meet monolithic flexure mount specifications; (3) Dimensional inspection report with actual vs nominal measurements on critical features; (4) Surface roughness certification per applicable standards. FAIR available on request.

faq.q: What is the MOQ and typical lead time for Flexure mount / Stage flexure lithography components?
faq.a: Standard MOQ: 1 unit for prototype evaluation. Production lead time: 15-25 business days depending on quantity. Rush orders (3-5 days) available. Contact our supply chain team for volume-based tiered pricing.
